environment.deterministic_policy: Fixed Python/NumPy/Torch seeds; manifest order; cudnn deterministic=True and benchmark=False. GPU/CPU tied-score NMS can differ; exact cross-device equality is not claimed.

rpn_config.proposal_order: Original filter_proposals output: batched_nms returns decreasing objectness score; keep is sliced by original post_nms_top_n, then [:K].
rpn_config.coordinate_system: xyxy pixels in transformed, unpadded ImageList.image_sizes; GT captured from the same original forward call
